1. Scope and operators

These terms cover the UnlikeOtherAI website at unlikeotherai.com and the UnlikeOtherAuthenticator sign-in and account service at authentication.unlikeotherai.com.

The website and shared sign-in service are operated by UnlikeOtherAI s.r.o., company number (IČO) 30001641, with its registered office at Pod Borováčkem 168, Myšlín, 251 64 Mnichovice, Czech Republic.

A separate agreement for a paid product, organisation account or project governs that engagement and takes priority on matters it specifically addresses. These terms do not introduce fees or replace an existing signed agreement.

Contact hello@unlikeotherai.com if you need to identify your service provider or have questions before using the service.

2. Your account

Use accurate account information and only sign in using an identity you are authorised to use. Keep your credentials and authentication factors secure. Do not share verification codes or impersonate another person.

If you use the service for an organisation, you must have its permission. Organisation administrators may control your membership, role and access to their workspaces. You remain responsible for respecting the organisation's policies.

Tell us promptly at hello@unlikeotherai.com if you suspect unauthorised account access. Do not include passwords or live authentication tokens in your message.

3. Permitted use

You may use the website and sign-in service for their intended purposes in accordance with applicable law. You must not bypass access controls, attempt to access someone else's account, disrupt the service, distribute malicious code or use it for fraud or unlawful activity.

If you discover a security issue, report it privately to our contact address with enough information for us to investigate, without exposing other users' information or continuing unauthorised access.

4. Connected products and privacy

UnlikeOtherAuthenticator verifies your identity and provides the selected product with relevant identity and access information. Each product has its own functionality, permissions and applicable terms. Google and other sign-in providers also apply their own terms to their services.

Google sign-in uses basic identity and profile permissions. Connections to messages, files, calendars or other product data require separate authorisation; signing in alone does not grant that access.

Our privacy policy explains the information used for the website and authentication, who receives it, and your rights. Stopping a provider connection, closing an authentication account and deleting a product's records are distinct actions. Contact us if you need help requesting the right one.

5. Availability, changes and ending access

Maintenance, technical failures and third-party outages can interrupt service. Unless a separate agreement says otherwise, we do not promise uninterrupted availability or a particular service level.

We may restrict or suspend access where reasonably necessary to address a security threat, unlawful activity, material misuse or a legal obligation. Where lawful and practicable, we will explain the reason and give an opportunity to resolve the issue. Contact us if you believe an access restriction is mistaken.

You may stop using the service or request account closure. Closing a shared sign-in account can affect access to multiple connected products. Organisational, billing and legal obligations may continue where applicable, and information is handled as described in the privacy policy.

6. Content, rights and responsibility

The website's content, branding and design are protected by applicable intellectual property law. You may view the website and share links to it. Any open-source software is governed by its accompanying licence; these terms do not replace that licence.

You retain your rights in information you provide. We use it as needed to operate the service, respond to you and fulfil applicable agreements, as explained in our privacy policy.

We are responsible for our services as required by applicable law and any agreement with you. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, limits mandatory consumer rights, or removes data protection rights. No exclusive court or governing-law rule here overrides protections available to you under applicable law.

7. Changes and contact

We may update these terms as the website or sign-in service develops. The date above identifies this version. We will give notice of material changes where required and obtain agreement where the law or your existing agreement requires it.

For support, account issues or questions about these terms, contact hello@unlikeotherai.com or write to our registered address in section 1.
